Explored initial state. Map confirmed: 14x10, player at (1,1), 3 lives, score 0, keys 0, coins 0, time 300, dash ready, gate shut. Enemies: e1 at (1,5) (row 5 horizontal patrol x1-x7), e2 at (9,3) moving to (9,2) after 1 tick. Spikes at (3,3) and (5,8). Gate at (8,3) connects (7,3)-(9,3). Locked door at (11,6) connects (11,5)-(11,7); key at (4,5). Exit at (12,7). Next: test bump into wall (up), coin collection, pause/resume, door/key, spikes, dash, lever/gate, exit, timers.

Testing basic mechanics. From map: player at (1,1), coin at (4,1). Next: test coin collection (rightx3), pause freeze (pause,wait,pause), wall bump (up at (1,1) already done - bump event works). Also need to test door/key, spikes, dash, lever/gate, exit. Enemy e1 patrols x1-x7 at y5, e2 at (9,3) moves to (9,2). Note: last run with [up] showed bump event, time dropped to 299, HUD matches state.

Tested basics: bump works (up at (1,1) shows bump, time 299), coin at (4,1) gives +100/coins=1, time drops 1/tick. Map mapped. Plan: verify pause freeze (timer/HUD frozen, inputs ignored while paused, resume resumes exactly), verify dash recharge/HUD, then door/key (key at (4,5), door at (10,6)), lever/gate ((1,8)/(8,3)), spikes/hurts, heart at max, score cap, time bonus, enemy swap-tile hit, dash over enemy middle tile. Path to lever: down to (1,5), right to (4,5) key, down to (4,8), left to (1,8). To reach right side need gate open then column 9 down to row 5, then door. Next run: pause freeze test seed 1.

Tested pause freeze (run4): paused stops timer/enemies, resume exact (time 299 with ev=[resume]). Dash test next: dash-right from (1,1) should land (3,1), cd=6 then 5 (Dash 5 HUD), 5 waits -> ready, then dash-right again lands (5,1) collecting (4,1) coin (coins=1). Also test second dash while cooldown>0 acts as step. Then pause+input ordering: [pause+left] should pause ignore move; [enter] resumes; [left+pause] should not move (no running tick) if correct; [up+right+down] should end with single down move to (1,2).

Tested pause freeze (run4): paused stops timer/enemies, resume exact (time 299 with ev=[resume]). Dash test (run5): dash-right from (1,1) lands (3,1), cd=6 then 5 (Dash 5 HUD), 5 waits -> ready, then dash-right again lands (5,1) collecting (4,1) coin (coins=1). Next: test pause+input ordering with [pause+left], [enter], [right], [right], [left+pause] to see whether move after pause in same tick is processed and whether pause state is correct. Also later test multiple movement keys (up+right+down) ends with single down, and dash while cooldown>0 acts as step.

Confirmed in run6 that pause+left resulted in ev=[pause,bump], i.e., the movement key after pause still acted (bump). Need to verify with pause+right: if the player moves despite pausing, that is a clear input_race bug. Also to test: multiple movement keys only last counts; dash during cooldown acts as step. Next run: [pause+right] from fresh seed 1.

Confirmed bug: pause+right in same tick moves player (ev=[pause,move], ended at (2,1) while paused) — violates 'pause takes effect immediately; rest of tick's input ignored'. Reported as input_race with minimal steps [pause+right] seed 1. Next: test multiple movement keys rule ('only the last one counts') via [right+left] from (1,1): expected bump (left is wall), no move. Later: dash during cooldown acts as step; door/key and gate/lever mechanics; spikes; heart cap; completion/time bonus; score cap; UI button clicks. Kept prior notes: wait/up no-op, right collects coin at (4,1), dash right to (3,1) and again after 5 waits to (5,1); pause freezes game and timer (run4), pause+left bump confirmed (run6).

reports.title: Pause + movement in same tick still moves the player
reports.observed: Running `pause+right` from a fresh seed 1 game pauses the game but the player moves from (1,1) to (2,1).
reports.expected: Pause takes effect immediately after being read, so the right movement key should be ignored; the player should stay at (1,1) and no other effects should occur that tick.

reports.title: Multiple movement keys in same tick all execute
reports.observed: Running `right+up` from (1,1) moves the player to (2,1), even though the last movement key is `up`. which is blocked by the wall at (1,0).
reports.expected: Only the last movement key in a tick should count; `up` is blocked, so the player should bump and remain at (1,1).

reports.title: Key collected in same tick as enemy hit is lost on respawn
reports.observed: The player picks up the key at (4,5) on the same tick an enemy hit occurs; after respawn the HUD Keys value is 0 instead of 1.
reports.expected: The player should keep all items collected in the same tick they lose a life, including the key, so HUD Keys should show 1 after respawn.
